basics.name: Abraham Yang 杨杨
basics.label: Senior Frontend Engineer / Frontend Lead
basics.summary: Senior Frontend Engineer / Frontend Lead with 7+ years of experience delivering complex web and cross-platform products and contributing to architecture across complex business applications. Experienced in independently owning React.js frontend architecture, technical decisions, engineering systems, real-time applications, SSR, Node.js services, and 0-to-1 product delivery. Hands-on with AI product development, including Dify-based RAG workflows, workflow orchestration, custom AI frontends, and AI-first engineering practices using Figma MCP and OpenAPI-driven tooling. Previously led cross-functional frontend teams and delivered products across APAC markets.

work.name: Trajectry (formerly EY Fabernovel China)
highlights: Owned frontend architecture and delivery across complex web and cross-platform products, spanning real-time systems, cross-platform applications, SSR websites, CMS, and AI-enabled experiences.

Designed frontend architecture for Christie's products including real-time communication, multi-account permissions, cross-platform monorepo structure, reusable component systems, and OpenAPI-based API integration.
Built and orchestrated Dify-based RAG workflows for a Richemont knowledge application, owning workflow and node logic as well as the custom frontend experience.

Applied an AI-first development workflow on Kallista, combining Figma MCP and OpenAPI/Orval-generated API definitions to provide structured context for LLM implementation while owning business logic, architecture boundaries, and code review.
Delivered products for global luxury and premium brands including Christie's, Richemont, Hermès, Kallista, Messika, Bucherer, Bulgari, and Monotype.

work.name: Shanghai RJY Information Technology Co., Ltd
highlights: Designed and implemented a customizable clothing platform with real-time 2D/3D rendering using React, Fabric.js, and Three.js.
Led frontend architecture and delivery for a DIY clothing application and WeChat Miniprogram, managed agile teams, and built CI/CD infrastructure.
Developed a Node.js headless rendering service to generate print-ready high-resolution output from user designs, enabling offline export without client-side rendering constraints.

work.name: Shanghai Fumasoft Co., Ltd
highlights: Refactored a React Native app into a WebView-based hybrid architecture, enabling a shared codebase across iOS, Android, and H5.
Led a cross-functional team of 5 engineers (FE, iOS, Android), coordinating sprint planning and technical decisions.

work.name: Publicis Sapient
highlights: Developed responsive campaign websites and minisites for Huawei, Marriott, and automotive brands.
Collaborated across Singapore, Japan, and India teams in a distributed delivery model.

projects.name: Christie's WeChat Miniprogram
projects.description: Ongoing frontend architecture and development for Christie's China WeChat Miniprogram, covering complex auction, account, and cross-platform workflows. Tech: Taro, React, WebSocket, Orval, pnpm Workspaces.
highlights: Owned frontend state organization and its ongoing evolution across complex auction and account workflows, progressively separating page logic into clearer hooks and business modules.
Designed a WebSocket manager handling dual concurrent connections (global + local), automatic reconnection, and session recovery for reliable online auction interactions.
Refactored the multi-account module to support authorized sub-account switching with per-account permission control and isolated state.
Built a reusable UI component system inspired by shadcn/ui, keeping component source fully owned and customizable for product requirements.
Restructured the codebase into a pnpm Workspaces monorepo supporting both WeChat Miniprogram and LINE LIFF, with shared components, utilities, and types.
Introduced Orval to generate API clients from OpenAPI specifications, reducing manual interface definition maintenance and keeping frontend and backend API structures aligned.

projects.name: Shantec Website (Independent Project)
projects.description: Independently architected and delivered a website from 0 to 1, applying experience gained from previous CMS projects. Tech: Next.js, Strapi, Tailwind CSS 4, Monorepo.
highlights: Owned the project end to end, including architecture, frontend implementation, Strapi CMS integration, and delivery.
Extended CMS experience gained from the Monotype project and independently applied it in a Strapi-based solution.
Structured the Web and CMS codebase as a monorepo and built the frontend with Next.js and Tailwind CSS 4.

projects.name: Richemont AI Knowledge Workflow
projects.description: AI-assisted research and knowledge retrieval workflow built on Richemont monthly reports using Dify knowledge base and workflow capabilities. Tech: Dify, RAG, LLM Workflow, Custom Frontend.
highlights: Worked with monthly report content indexed in a Dify knowledge base so relevant knowledge chunks could be retrieved as context for user queries.
Owned workflow orchestration and node logic across task execution, conditional decisions, and workflow progression.
Built the custom frontend experience that exposed the multi-stage AI workflow as an interactive product.

projects.name: Kallista Miniprogram — AI-first Development
projects.description: Production Miniprogram delivered with an AI-first engineering workflow designed to make implementation and ongoing maintenance highly LLM-friendly. Tech: React, Taro, Figma MCP, OpenAPI, Orval, LLM Coding.
highlights: Decomposed Figma designs into explicit component boundaries and used Figma MCP to provide structured design context for implementation.
Used Orval to generate API clients and interface types from backend OpenAPI specifications, giving the LLM machine-readable API definitions instead of relying on guessed endpoints or data structures.
Focused human effort on business rules, architecture and component boundaries, edge cases, and code review while delegating substantial CRUD and repetitive implementation to LLM coding tools.

Explored an engineering model better suited to long-term AI maintenance, using design context, API definitions, and code boundaries as explicit constraints to reduce uncertainty during implementation.

projects.name: Monotype Asia Website
projects.description: Built and localized the Monotype Asia website for China Mainland, Taiwan, and Korea in collaboration with a backend engineer. Tech: Astro, Tailwind, Strapi, SSR, i18n, Node.js.
highlights: Architected the Web-side Astro SSR solution for deployment across China Mainland, Taiwan, and Korea, with region-specific locale, routing, and configuration.
Collaborated with the backend engineer responsible for the Strapi CMS layer to integrate content, while primarily owning the Web-side solution and implementation.
Worked on multi-region and multi-environment delivery, gaining CMS experience that was later applied independently in the Shantec project.

projects.name: Tootools Miniprogram
projects.description: Full-featured WeChat Miniprogram for custom clothing design with real-time 2D editing and 3D preview, serving as the core product of the company. Tech: React, Fabric.js, Three.js, Uniapp, Node.js.
highlights: Architected a dual-rendering design editor with layer management, pattern/font/drawing tools, and undo/redo history, built on a rendering abstraction layer that decouples UI logic from Fabric.js and Three.js internals.
Implemented real-time 3D preview by projecting user designs onto glTF clothing models via Three.js Decal Geometry.
Built server-side rendering workflow with Node.js to export high-resolution print-ready design assets.

projects.name: Fumamx Hybrid App
projects.description: Rebuilt a React Native SaaS application into a hybrid architecture to improve user experience and accelerate cross-platform delivery. Tech: React Native, Vue.js, JS Bridge, iOS, Android.
highlights: Designed and implemented a bidirectional JS bridge using postMessage, enabling structured communication between WebView and native iOS/Android layers.

projects.name: DS Automobile Official Website
projects.description: Developed the official marketing website for DS Automobile China. Tech: JavaScript, CSS Animation, Baidu Map SDK.
highlights: Built a high-fidelity animated landing page with scroll-driven and entrance animations using CSS and JavaScript.
Integrated Baidu Map SDK with custom markers, cluster rendering, and fuzzy search for a nationwide dealer network.

projects.name: IQOS EDM Email Templates
projects.description: Delivered a series of responsive EDM email templates for IQOS marketing campaigns, coordinated across APAC teams. Tech: MJML, Gulp.js, Litmus.
highlights: Built responsive, cross-client email templates using MJML, validated across 15+ email clients via Litmus.
Automated email compilation and asset inlining with a Gulp-based build workflow.

projects.name: Huawei Campaign Minisites
projects.description: Developed multiple interactive marketing minisites for Huawei campaigns, focusing on mobile-first experiences and map integration. Tech: React.js, Canvas, Tencent Map, WeChat JSSDK, Swiper.js.
highlights: Built canvas-based interactive mobile experience with gesture controls and frame animation for campaign engagement.
Extended Swiper.js with custom card collapse and 3D flip transitions to match design specifications.

projects.name: Marriott Website CN Localization
projects.description: Adapted Marriott's global website for the Chinese market, replacing unsupported third-party services and ensuring feature parity. Tech: JavaScript, Baidu Map SDK.
highlights: Re-implemented Google Maps-based hotel locator with Baidu Map SDK, preserving search, filtering, and marker functionality for CN users.
Collaborated with the India-based development team.
